prompt: A screen redraws 120 times a second. How many milliseconds does each frame get, to one decimal place?
An animation driven from JavaScript stutters while a list is loading. Why then?

choices.text: Lists use the GPU
choices.why: The GPU is not the bottleneck here.

choices.text: The UI thread pauses while data arrives over the network
Its thread is busy, so frames come late
choices.why: Right: each frame waits for JavaScript.

choices.text: Animations are disabled during fetches

prompt: Which properties can the native side animate without JavaScript? Choose all that apply.

choices.text: `opacity`
`width`
choices.why: Yoga would have to recompute the layout.

choices.text: `transform` with `scaleX`
choices.why: Yes: that is what the week bar uses.

choices.text: `padding`

prompt: Why is the value created with `useRef(new Animated.Value(share)).current`?

choices.text: So it is made once and kept between renders
choices.why: Right: a new one each render would restart.

choices.text: Refs are faster to read than state
`Animated.Value` cannot be created outside a ref
choices.why: It can; it would just be new every time.

choices.text: The native driver requires every animated value to live inside a ref
choices.why: It requires nothing of the kind.

prompt: The bar scales with `scaleX` but also moves by half its width before and after. What would happen without the two moves?

choices.text: Nothing visible
It would grow beyond the track and past the edge of the screen
choices.why: The track clips it, and the share stays under 1.

choices.text: The native driver would refuse the animation
It would shrink towards its centre
choices.why: Right: a scale is about the middle.

prompt: What can a Reanimated worklet do that the native driver cannot?

choices.text: Animate `opacity`
Run on a phone without the JavaScript engine that the app carries
choices.why: A worklet is JavaScript, on a second runtime.

choices.text: Follow a finger
choices.why: Right, frame by frame: the next value is not known in advance.

choices.text: Animate `width` without a layout

prompt: `activeOffsetX: [-12, 12]` is set on the pan. What does it protect?

choices.text: The server from repeated requests
The row from moving to the right of where it was
Vertical scrolling of the list
